authority.scope: Unchanged upstream CTranslate2 conversion files of OpenAI Whisper medium.en, downloaded from the source and never shipped. The user downloads it on first use for dictation. From Plebian-OS 0.2.3 RC5 an online upgrade also downloads it by default for Kilix Playalong unless the machine's configuration declines (see distribution). The licence text, statement and advisory are the faster-whisper-small-en ones; only the artifact differs.
